title: Kynolith canon entry
description: One canon or narrative entry stored in Data/ JSON. canon_tag is a string. The only tag that may omit approval_ref is the exact value UNAPPROVED. Other tag values are not enumerated. approval_ref resolution is checked by Tools/canon_validator.py.

canon_tag.description: Short tag. The docs require the exact uppercase value UNAPPROVED when approval_ref is omitted, and do not enumerate other tags, so the pattern allows that alphabet rather than lowercase only. Empty fails canon_tag_empty in the validator.

source_pages.description: Non-empty array of integers. For non-placeholder text, Tools/canon_validator.py requires every page to be from 8 through 20 inclusive. Placeholder entries may omit this field.
